readmeHtml:
Awesome DeepSeek Agent

English | 简体中文

A curated list of guides for integrating DeepSeek models into popular AI agent and coding-assistant tools.

Each guide walks through installation, configuration, and first run — so you can start using DeepSeek-V4-Pro or DeepSeek-V4-Flash inside your favorite tool in a few minutes.

Contents

Tool Description Guide
AstrBot Open-source agent assistant for Feishu, Telegram and more, extensible with skills, plugins, and MCPs. Guide
Cherry Studio Open-source cross-platform desktop AI client with 300+ assistants, MCP support, knowledge bases, and multi-model chat. Guide
Claude Code AI coding assistant that runs in the terminal. Guide
Cline AI coding assistant extension for VS Code supporting multiple API providers. Guide
Codex OpenAI's coding agent. Guide
Crush Glamorous open-source AI coding agent for the terminal with multi-model support and LSP integration. Guide
Deep Code Open-source terminal AI coding assistant for the DeepSeek-V4 model with deep thinking, reasoning effort control, and Agent Skills. Guide
DeepSeek-TUI Open-source Rust terminal coding assistant for DeepSeek-V4 — Codex-style architecture, sandboxed tools, MCP client + server, 1M context. Guide
GitHub Copilot AI peer programmer built into VS Code. Guide
GitHub Copilot CLI Terminal-native AI coding assistant with agentic capabilities. Guide
Hermes Open-source self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research. Guide
Kilo Code AI coding assistant available as a CLI and editor extension. Guide
Langcli Open-source AI coding assistant that is 100% compatible with Claude Code and supports mainstream LLM models Guide
LobeHub LobeHub is your Chief Agent Operator, organizing your agents into 7×24 operations by hiring, scheduling, and reporting on your entire AI team. Guide
nanobot Open-source lightweight AI agent with chat platform integration, memory, MCP, and more. Guide
Oh My Pi Terminal AI coding agent forked from Pi with OMP-specific tools, model roles, MCP, plugins, and agent workflows. Guide
OpenClaw Open-source personal AI assistant that plugs into chat tools (Feishu, WeChat) and is extensible via Skills. Guide
OpenCode Open-source AI coding assistant available in terminal, web, and other forms. Guide
Pi Minimal, extensible terminal coding harness with tree-structured sessions and custom providers. Guide
Qwen Code Coding agent CLI by the Alibaba Qwen team — now with built-in DeepSeek provider support. Guide
Reasonix DeepSeek-native coding agent that runs in the terminal — cache-first loop, MCP-native. Guide
WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy AI agent and coding assistant with custom OpenAI-compatible model configuration. Guide

Resources

  • DeepSeek Platform — get an API key.
  • DeepSeek API Docs — API reference and guides.

Contributing

Have another tool you'd like to see here? See CONTRIBUTING.md for guidelines on opening an issue or a pull request with a new guide.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A curated index of tools, CLIs, and editor extensions built on top of the DeepSeek AI ecosystem.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository acts as a central index for the growing ecosystem of tools, command-line interfaces, and editor extensions built on top of DeepSeek's AI models. It catalogs open-source and proprietary projects that leverage DeepSeek for tasks ranging from terminal-based coding assistance to complex, multi-agent orchestrations. Each entry includes links to documentation and specific setup guides, making it easy for developers to discover and evaluate different agent harnesses. The collection highlights the versatility of DeepSeek in powering modern developer tools, autonomous systems, and IDE integrations.
keyFeatures: Categorized Agent List: Organizes tools by platform, such as terminal CLIs, editor extensions, and standalone web apps.
Detailed Project Guides: Provides direct links to specific documentation and usage guides for each featured agent.
Ecosystem Aggregation: Compiles both official and community-driven projects built around the DeepSeek API.
Open Source Focus: Highlights open-source solutions that developers can audit, fork, and extend for their own needs.
Integration Patterns: Showcases various ways to integrate DeepSeek into existing developer workflows and IDEs.
